speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Home. The fold is the fold. I am not opening it to add the sentence she told me not to add.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The chronicle is on the shelf, under the cat or beside him. It is staying. I said so by the fire, and the shelf agrees.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The letter is the other paper. It is not the pages. It does not go out tonight because I am tired. It does not go out because I have not named a man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Enough. The candle can do the rest of the room without a speech.
